summary: Willis Lease Finance Corp filed an 8-K reporting its execution of a Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire three commercial buildings totaling 375,000 square feet in Coconut Creek, Florida for $118.0 million. The properties are intended to support corporate headquarters, spare parts, maintenance repair, overhaul, and engine storage operations. Closing is subject to customary conditions. This is a routine real estate acquisition for operational purposes, not a strategic special-situation event such as an M&A transaction, restructuring, or capital markets action. No additional deal terms or advisors were disclosed.
